# Michael's Treasures

> Vintage watch dealer in Prague, Czechia, run personally by Michal Sopoliga.
> Exceptional vintage watches — mainly from the 1940s–1950s — personally
> selected, inspected and photographed, with a focus on originality and
> condition. Viewings in Prague by appointment. Fully insured worldwide
> shipping.

## About

- Business: Michael's Treasures (sole trader: Michal Sopoliga, IČO 22533834)
- Address: Slavíkova 1379/20, 130 00 Prague, Czechia
- Viewings: by appointment in Prague
- Website: https://praguevintagewatches.com
- Email: michael.treasures1@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/michaels.treasures (@michaels.treasures)
- Serves: EU and worldwide (tracked, fully insured shipping)

## What Michael's Treasures offers

- Curated vintage mechanical watches, mainly 1940s–1950s, selected for
  originality, condition and character — honest, unpolished examples
  photographed exactly as they are.
- Any known replaced parts or deviations from originality are always
  clearly disclosed before a sale.
- Every watch is inspected and tested for accuracy before being offered;
  servicing prior to delivery can be arranged with an experienced
  watchmaker, and professionally serviced watches carry a 24-month service
  warranty.
- The available stock changes constantly; every new arrival is first shared
  on Instagram, typically weekly. There is no static catalogue.
- Also buys vintage watches and entire collections — collectors thinking of
  selling can enquire by email, Instagram or the website contact form.

## How buying works

1. Enquire — via Instagram or the website contact form.
2. Personal consultation — additional photographs, movement shots, videos
   or servicing on request; in-person viewings in Prague by appointment.
3. Delivery — carefully packaged, shipped fully insured worldwide with
   tracking (typically dispatched within 24 hours of payment), or handed
   over in person in Prague. Payment by bank transfer (preferred), cash in
   person, or by agreement Wise/Revolut/PayPal. An invoice is issued for
   every purchase. EU consumers have a 14-day right of withdrawal for
   distance purchases.

## FAQ

- Are the watches authentic? Watches are selected for originality,
  condition and character; any known replaced parts or deviations from
  originality are always clearly disclosed before a sale.
- Are the watches serviced? Every watch is inspected and tested for
  accuracy before being offered; where servicing is required or
  recommended, it can be carried out prior to delivery.
- Do you buy vintage watches? Yes — quality vintage watches and entire
  collections.
- How do I pay? Bank transfer preferred; cash for in-person meetings in
  Prague. An invoice is issued for every purchase.
